```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

real_coefficients_vector <- function(dimention,
                                     zeta,
                                     r,
                                     pseudo_size = 1000) {
  # generate real beta vector shown in paper

  real_coefficients0 <- c(rep(0, dimention))

  # ζ zeta proportion of the coordinates of β(0) is randomly selected and set to 1
  real_coefficients0[sample(dimention, (dimention) * zeta, replace = FALSE)] <- 1
  real_coefficients0 <- c(0, rnorm(dimention) * real_coefficients0)
  pseudo_covariate <- observed_covariate_vector(dimention, pseudo_size, 0, diag(rep(1, dimention)), 0.5)
  coefficients_scale <- 1

  repeat {
    real_coefficients <- real_coefficients0 * coefficients_scale
    real_coefficients[1] <- -mean(pseudo_covariate %*% real_coefficients[-1])
    pseudo_response <- get_mean("binomial")(pseudo_covariate, coefficients = real_coefficients)
    oracle_error <- mean(1 - abs(1 - 2 * pseudo_response)) / 2
    if (abs(oracle_error - r) < 0.005) {
      break
    }
    coefficients_scale <- ifelse(oracle_error > r, coefficients_scale * 1.1, coefficients_scale * 0.9)
  }
  return(real_coefficients)
}

observed_covariate_vector <- function(dimention, # number of columns
                                      sample_size, # number of rows
                                      Z_mean,
                                      Z_variance,
                                      Z_corr) {
  # generate observed covariate vector from Gaussian random vector Z

  X_i <- Z_i <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = sample_size,
    mu = rep(Z_mean, dimention),
    Sigma = correlation_matrix(Z_corr, dimention) %*% Z_variance
  )


  # set Xi,j = 2 · 1Zi,j >0 − 1, 2j < p Zi,j , 2j ≥ p
  X_i[, 1:floor(dimention / 2)] <- 2 * (Z_i[, 1:floor(dimention / 2)] > 0) - 1

  return(X_i)
}
```

# Introduction

This is one other __catalytic__ vignettes go into the particularities of example of logistic regression from paper.

```{r data, eval=TRUE}
library(catalytic)
sample_size <- 100 # observed data sample size
dimention <- 30 # number of covariate

Z_corr <- 0.5
Z_mean <- 0
Z_variance <- 1

zeta <- 0.75
r <- 0.1

observed_covariate <- as.data.frame(observed_covariate_vector(
  dimention,
  sample_size,
  Z_mean,
  diag(rep(Z_variance, dimention)),
  Z_corr
))

real_coefficients <- real_coefficients_vector(dimention, zeta, r)

observed_response <- data.frame(y = get_data(
  "binomial"
)(
  n = nrow(observed_covariate),
  mean = get_mean("binomial")(observed_covariate, coefficients = real_coefficients)
))

obs_data <- cbind(observed_covariate, observed_response)

data_ <- data_initialization(y ~ 1, binomial, obs_data)
head(obs_data)

real_coefficients
```

Let's see how is works in glm.

```{r glm}
glm_model <- stats::glm(y ~ ., family = binomial, data = data_$data)
```

Let's do a simple test on them.

```{r}
err <- function(x,
                coefficients0,
                coefficients1) {
  return(mean(get_discrepancy("logarithmic_error")(Y = get_mean("binomial")(x, coefficients = coefficients0), est_Y = get_mean("binomial")(x, coefficients = coefficients1))))
}

Z_corr <- 0.5
Z_mean <- 0
Z_variance <- 1
z <- 0.75 # nonsparsity
r <- 0.1 # oracle classification error


sample_size <- 3 # observed data sample size CHANGE
dimention <- 2 # number of covariate CHNAGE
M <- 20

init_taus <- seq(1, 100, 20) # CHANGE
simulation_times <- 2 # CHANGE

iter <- 7
warmup <- 3

log_stan_model_file <- "~/catalytic/R/rstan_script/binomial_joint_bayesian_theta_lognorm.stan"

beta_stan_model_file <- "~/catalytic/R/rstan_script/binomial_joint_bayesian_theta_beta.stan"

exp_stan_model_file <- "~/catalytic/R/rstan_script/binomial_joint_bayesian_theta_exp.stan"


glm_results <-
  freq_boots_results <-
  freq_stein_results <-
  freq_cv_results <-
  bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_results <-
  bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_results <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_mean_results <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_mean_results <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_mean_results <-
  bayes_gibbs_5_mean_results <-
  glm_times <-
  freq_boots_times <-
  freq_stein_times <-
  freq_cv_times <-
  bayes_tau_01_nuts_times <-
  bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_times <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_times <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_bets_nuts_times <-
  bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_times <-
  bayes_gibbs_5_times <-
  c()

suppressWarnings(
  for (t in (1:simulation_times)) {
    set.seed(t)
    cat("\nsimulation times:", t)

    observed_covariate <- observed_covariate_vector(
      dimention,
      sample_size,
      Z_mean,
      diag(rep(Z_variance, dimention)),
      Z_corr
    )
    print("observed_covariate")
    print(observed_covariate)
    real_coefficients <- real_coefficients_vector(dimention, z, r)

    observed_response <- data.frame(y = get_data("binomial")(
      n = sample_size,
      mean = get_mean("binomial")(X = observed_covariate,
        coefficients = real_coefficients)
    ))
    obs_data <- cbind(observed_covariate, observed_response)

    data_ <- data_initialization(y ~ 1, family = binomial(), data = obs_data, syn_size = M)


    cat("\nglm")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    glm_coefficients <- stats::glm(y ~ ., family = binomial(), data = obs_data)$coefficients
    glm_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")

    cat("\nfreq_boots")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    freq_boots <- cat_glm_tune(y ~ .,
      family = binomial(),
      data_ = data_,
      risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
      discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
      taus = init_taus
    )
    freq_boots_coefficients <- freq_boots$coefficients
    freq_boots_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")

    cat("\nfreq_stein_coefficients")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    freq_stein <- cat_glm_tune(y ~ .,
      family = binomial(),
      data_ = data_,
      risk_estimate_method = "steinian_estimate",
      discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
      taus = init_taus
    )
    freq_stein_coefficients <- freq_stein$coefficients
    freq_stein_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")

    cat("\nfreq_cv")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    freq_cv <- cat_glm_tune(y ~ .,
      family = binomial(),
      data_ = data_,
      risk_estimate_method = "cross_validation",
      discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
      taus = init_taus
    )
    freq_cv_coefficients <- freq_cv$coefficients
    freq_cv_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")


    cat("\nbayes_tau_01_NUTS_model")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_tau_01_nuts_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      tau_lower = 0.1,
      algorithm = "NUTS"
    )
    bayes_tau_01_nuts_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")

    bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_coefficients <- rstan::summary(bayes_tau_01_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary[
      grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_01_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary)),
      "mean"
    ]

    cat("\nbayes_theta_2pn_nuts_model")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      use_theta = TRUE,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      alpha = 2 + 2 * dimention / sample_size,
      algorithm = "NUTS"
    )
    bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")
    bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_coefficients <- rstan::summary(bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary[
      grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary)),
      "mean"
    ]



    cat("\nbayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_model")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      use_theta = TRUE,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      stan_model_file = log_stan_model_file,
      algorithm = "NUTS"
    )
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_mean_coefficients <- rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary[
      grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary)),
      "mean"
    ]

    cat("\nbayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_model")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      use_theta = TRUE,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      stan_model_file = beta_stan_model_file,
      algorithm = "NUTS"
    )
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_mean_coefficients <- rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary[
      grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary)),
      "mean"
    ]

    cat("\nbayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_model")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      use_theta = TRUE,
      iter = iter,
      warmup = warmup,
      stan_model_file = exp_stan_model_file,
      algorithm = "NUTS"
    )
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")
    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_mean_coefficients <- rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary[
      grep("beta", rownames(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_model$sample_model)$summary)),
      "mean"
    ]


    cat("cat_joint_bayesian_gibbs_glm")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    bayes_gibbs_5_model <- cat_glm_bayes_joint_gibbs(
      y ~ .,
      family = binomial,
      data_ = data_,
      gibbs_iter = iter,
      gibbs_warmup = warmup
    )
    bayes_gibbs_5_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")
    bayes_gibbs_5_mean_coefficients <- bayes_gibbs_5_model$inform_df[-1, "mean"]




    test_x <- observed_covariate_vector(
      dimention,
      1000,
      Z_mean,
      diag(rep(Z_variance, dimention)),
      Z_corr
    )

    glm_results <- append(
      glm_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, glm_coefficients)
    )
    freq_boots_results <- append(
      freq_boots_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, freq_boots_coefficients)
    )
    freq_stein_results <- append(
      freq_stein_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, freq_stein_coefficients)
    )
    freq_cv_results <- append(
      freq_cv_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, freq_cv_coefficients)
    )

    bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_coefficients)
    )

    bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_coefficients)
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_mean_coefficients)
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_mean_coefficients)
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_mean_coefficients)
    )


    bayes_gibbs_5_mean_results <- append(
      bayes_gibbs_5_mean_results,
      err(test_x, real_coefficients, bayes_gibbs_5_mean_coefficients)
    )

    glm_times <- append(
      glm_times,
      glm_time
    )
    freq_boots_times <- append(
      freq_boots_times,
      freq_boots_time
    )
    freq_stein_times <- append(
      freq_stein_times,
      freq_stein_time
    )
    freq_cv_times <- append(
      freq_cv_times,
      freq_cv_time
    )

    bayes_tau_01_nuts_times <- append(
      bayes_tau_01_nuts_times,
      bayes_tau_01_nuts_time
    )

    bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_times <- append(
      bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_times,
      bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_time
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_times <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_times,
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_lognorm_nuts_time
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_times <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_times,
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_beta_nuts_time
    )

    bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_times <- append(
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_times,
      bayes_theta_joint_alpha_exp_nuts_time
    )

    bayes_gibbs_5_times <- append(
      bayes_gibbs_5_times,
      bayes_gibbs_5_time
    )
  }
)
```



```{r result}
# Define the list of methods
methods <- c(
  "glm",
  "freq_boots",
  "freq_stein",
  "freq_cv",
  "bayes_tau_01_mean",
  "bayes_theta_2pn_mean",
  "bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean",
  "bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean",
  "bayes_tau_ppn_mean",
  "bayes_theta_ppn_mean",
  "bayes_tau_ppn_nuts_mean",
  "bayes_theta_ppn_nuts_mean",
  "bayes_gibbs_5_mean"
)

times_list <- list(
  glm_times,
  freq_boots_times,
  freq_stein_times,
  freq_cv_times,
  bayes_tau_01_times,
  bayes_theta_2pn_times,
  bayes_tau_01_nuts_times,
  bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_times,
  bayes_tau_ppn_times,
  bayes_theta_ppn_times,
  bayes_tau_ppn_nuts_times,
  bayes_theta_ppn_nuts_times,
  bayes_gibbs_5_times
)

# Define the list of results
results_list <- list(
  glm_results,
  freq_boots_results,
  freq_stein_results,
  freq_cv_results,
  bayes_tau_01_mean_results,
  bayes_theta_2pn_mean_results,
  bayes_tau_01_nuts_mean_results,
  bayes_theta_2pn_nuts_mean_results,
  bayes_tau_ppn_mean_results,
  bayes_theta_ppn_mean_results,
  bayes_tau_ppn_nuts_mean_results,
  bayes_theta_ppn_nuts_mean_results,
  bayes_gibbs_5_mean_results
)

# Calculate mean and standard error for each method
means <- sapply(results_list, mean)
ses <- sapply(results_list, function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)))
mean_time <- round(sapply(times_list, mean), 2)
ses_time <- round(sapply(times_list, function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))), 2)

# Create the dataframe
results <- data.frame(
  Method = methods,
  Mean = means,
  SE = ses,
  mean_time = mean_time,
  ses_time = ses_time
)
```
